mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP2D6 metabolism, with sertraline being a moderate inhibitor and tolterodine being a substrate, leading to increased tolterodine levels; additive anticholinergic effects may occur.
action: Monitor for tolterodine adverse effects (urinary retention, constipation, cognitive effects); consider dose reduction of tolterodine or alternative anticholinergic with less CYP2D6 interaction; counsel on CNS and anticholinergic symptom awareness.
